typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' Mobile Variant. Radical weight contrast. Technical but highly readable.
typography.primary_font: IBM Plex Sans (or system equivalent geometric sans like San Francisco/Roboto with adjusted tracking)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactile, sharp inner contrasts. We are avoiding standard soft shadows to maintain the 'Light Sentinel' technical edge.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on most cards. Use 2px left-border highlights to denote threat levels (Red/Yellow/Green).

message.js.layout: Segmented control or tabbed input at the top (Text vs Link vs Photo). Large, tap-friendly input area.
ui_details: Text/Link Input: Large minimum height (minHeight: 120), 1px solid border (#E5E7EB), focuses to #2563EB.
Screenshot Intake: Dashed border dropzone/tap-zone, icon-heavy, immediate preview thumbnail upon selection.
Action Button: Full width, bottom-anchored, highly visible 'Investigate' button.

check.js.layout: Centered progress indicator with staggered loading steps, or a bottom sheet for permission requests.
ui_details: Progress Steps: Vertical list showing current state (e.g., 'Extracting text...', 'Checking reputation...', 'Higgins AI analyzing...').
Permissions (Guided): Bottom sheet modal. Icon + Title + 'Why we need this' explanation. Primary CTA to 'Open Settings'.
Return-State Recheck: Visual spinner on app re-entry confirming permission status.

MessageAssessmentResult.js.layout: Bento-style scrollable view. Strict visual hierarchy prioritizing the threat level and the single next action.
ui_details: Threat Header: Massive Typography (Scam / Genuine / Ambiguous). Background tint (10% opacity of status color) with stark icon.
Higgins AI Card: The core element. Distinct visual treatment (e.g., subtle blue left-border, custom AI icon). Must show: 'Findings', 'Uncertainty level', and 'Exact Response'.
Single Action Button: Sticky at the bottom of the screen. High contrast. (e.g., 'Block Sender', 'Delete Message').
Privacy Disclosure: Small, muted text at the very bottom with a Lock icon: 'Purpose-limited processing. Data deleted in 15 mins.'

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. React Native Flexbox gaps: 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48. Padding inside cards must be 16px or 24px minimum.
layouts.screen_structure: Use SafeAreaView. Header is minimal. Main content is ScrollView. Action buttons are strictly anchored to the bottom using position 'absolute' or Flex 'space-between'.

motion.philosophy: Functional and authoritative. No bouncy/playful animations.
interactions: Use LayoutAnimation or Reanimated for expanding/collapsing Higgins' detailed findings.
Subtle opacity transition (200ms) when threat levels render.
Spinner/Skeleton loaders must use linear, precise sweeps, not soft pulses.

accessibility.contrast: All text must meet APCA / WCAG AA standard against background. Higgins AI explanations must use high-contrast dark grey/black.
accessibility.screen_reader: All status icons (threat levels) must have explicit accessibilityLabels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and key text nodes MUST include testID (React Native equivalent of data-testid). E.g., testID='higgins-explanation-text', testID='action-button-block'.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native / Expo environment. Do NOT use web-only paradigms (no DOM, no Tailwind standard classes unless NativeWind is explicitly configured; default to StyleSheet).
Focus STRICTLY on improving message.js, check.js, and MessageAssessmentResult.js.
Higgins consumer experience is the P0 priority here. Ensure the AI explanation clearly delineates 'Findings', 'Uncertainty', and 'Action'.
Preserve the existing Apollo V1 GuardDog logic, just wire the UI to consume the new deep threat investigation endpoints and Gemini responses.
Do NOT mock the 15-minute deletion text; ensure the UI clearly states this privacy limitation.
For testability, map the requested 'data-testid' rule to React Native's 'testID' prop.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive mobile frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using shadows/elevation in RN).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for overlays where text sits on top.
Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., adjust padding for buttons with icons to look perfectly centered).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, or sharp rectangular with 8px radius) with interaction feedback (TouchableHighlight/TouchableOpacity).
NEVER use generic AI emoji (🤖🧠💭) as primary UI icons. Use standard vector icons (e.g., from Lucide-react-native or Expo vector icons).
